description: Osuwiska na terenie Szczecina is a dataset listed in dane.gov.pl, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Urząd Miasta Szczecin. Landslides in Szczecin. Coverage: Urząd Miasta Szczecin. The portal shows the English title as "Landslides" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Urząd Miasta Szczecin. Its keywords include aktywności, karty, skarpy, rejestracyjne, stopie, osuwiska. The listing shows 2 download or service links in JSON, XLSX. The listing shows 2025-12-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dane-gov-pl.
